offering_description.value: Limbach designs, installs, upgrades, and maintains mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems for building owners and general contractors. It delivers the work through engineering teams, prefabrication shops, and field crews.

primary_services.value: building systems engineering; equipment installation and replacement; preventive maintenance and repair; building automation and controls; mechanical and plumbing prefabrication

customer_segment.value: B2B: Commercial and institutional building owners, facility managers, and general contractors

end_markets.value: healthcare; industrial manufacturing; data centers; life sciences; higher education

revenue_model.value: project or contract: Building systems design, installation, upgrades, and scheduled maintenance agreements; service fees: On-demand troubleshooting and equipment repairs

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Sources equipment and materials, then designs, installs, and services building systems for owners and general contractors

geography_served.value: US national: United States, with operations concentrated in the Northeast, Mid-Atlantic, Midwest, and Southeast

specialization.value: related lines: HVAC, plumbing, electrical systems, building automation, and equipment maintenance

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Direct sales to building owners and facility managers; partners / resellers: General contractors that subcontract building systems work

regulatory_exposure.value: high: State and local trade licensing for mechanical, electrical, and plumbing contracting, plus building codes and OSHA standards

notes: The current extent of direct government contracting is uncertain.
